study_title: Replication of the Bruen et al. 2006 PhiPack Benchmark Suite

reference.citation: Bruen, T. C., Philippe, H., & Bryant, D. (2006). A simple and robust statistical test for detecting the presence of recombination. Genetics, 172(4), 2665-2681.

data_provenance.og_data_note: Original synthetic alignments were simulated using Treevolve and Hudson's coalescent in 2006; alignments were not deposited in an online repository. Regenerated strictly from published parameters.
